RY-L02-S01-A01.title: Chakras
RY-L02-S01-A01.description: Working with chakras, subtle bodies, cleansing and harmonisation of energetic centres.
RY-L02-S01-A01.effect: Intended to synchronise body awareness and subtle-body imagery and strengthen the overall resource state.

RY-L02-S01-A02.title: Wu Xing
RY-L02-S01-A02.description: Working with organs, seasons, the five elements and emotional harmonisation in the source model.
RY-L02-S01-A02.effect: Intended to help perceive the body as an integrated system and support balanced attention to its functions.

RY-L02-S01-A03.title: Meridians
RY-L02-S01-A03.description: Working with channels of vital energy according to the Chinese-medicine model used by the course.
RY-L02-S01-A03.effect: Intended to cleanse and fill the meridian model while aligning annual, monthly and daily rhythms.

RY-L02-S01-A04.title: Hypnosis
RY-L02-S01-A04.description: Accessing deeper layers of the subconscious for positive suggestions.
RY-L02-S01-A04.effect: Intended to reinforce new states and work with unconscious patterns.

RY-L02-S02-A01.title: Golden Calf
RY-L02-S02-A01.description: Connecting consciousness with symbolic money and social egregores.
RY-L02-S02-A01.effect: Intended to strengthen the relationship with financial flow and resource.

RY-L02-S02-A02.title: Money and Chakras
RY-L02-S02-A02.description: Exploring receiving and attracting money at different levels of consciousness.
RY-L02-S02-A02.effect: Intended to identify where material flow feels blocked in the source model.

RY-L02-S02-A03.title: V.I.P.
RY-L02-S02-A03.description: Attunement to the symbolic field of influential business people.
RY-L02-S02-A03.effect: Intended to support confidence, status and steadiness in action.

RY-L02-S03-A01.title: Archetypes
RY-L02-S03-A01.description: Selecting a useful behavioural model for a communication situation.
RY-L02-S03-A01.effect: Intended to support greater freedom in groups and better understanding of another person.

RY-L02-S03-A02.title: Tantra
RY-L02-S03-A02.description: A practice focused on attraction and upward transformation of sexual energy.
RY-L02-S03-A02.effect: Used to explore the energy of relationships and bodily intimacy.

RY-L02-S03-A03.title: Attunement
RY-L02-S03-A03.description: Symbolic alignment of partners' chakras and relationship harmonisation.
RY-L02-S03-A03.effect: Intended to support mutual understanding and contact.

RY-L02-S03-A04.title: Easy Communication
RY-L02-S03-A04.description: A mode of natural communication with less tension and over-control.
RY-L02-S03-A04.effect: Intended to support ease, rapport and simpler social interaction.

RY-L02-S04-A01.title: Life-Flow Activation
RY-L02-S04-A01.description: Attunement to the natural life energy of the Earth, animals, trees and plants.
RY-L02-S04-A01.effect: Described as supporting restoration, well-being and emotional stability.

RY-L02-S04-A02.title: Fetch
RY-L02-S04-A02.description: Connection with the symbolic channel of a totem animal or guardian spirit.
RY-L02-S04-A02.effect: Used to cultivate missing qualities, protection and a stronger sense of vitality.

RY-L02-S04-A03.title: Fountain of Life
RY-L02-S04-A03.description: A source-tradition practice associated with renewal and regeneration at the cellular level.
RY-L02-S04-A03.effect: Presented historically as supporting restoration and a stronger sense of vitality.

RY-L02-S04-A04.title: Love and Compassion
RY-L02-S04-A04.description: Expansion of awareness and symbolic connection with the consciousness of the world.
RY-L02-S04-A04.effect: Intended to develop softness, openness and a sense of connection with life.

RY-L02-S05-A01.title: Genital Cleansing
RY-L02-S05-A01.description: A source-system cleansing practice for emotional, toxic and stagnant layers associated with sexuality.
RY-L02-S05-A01.effect: Intended to release bodily energy and restore a more natural sense of flow.

RY-L02-S05-A02.title: Activation of Sexual Centres
RY-L02-S05-A02.effect: Intended to increase bodily energy and sensitivity.

RY-L02-S05-A03.title: Wheel of Immortality
RY-L02-S05-A03.description: A practice of transforming sexual energy and directing it upward.
RY-L02-S05-A03.effect: Described as using internal energetic 'pumps' for renewal of body and consciousness.

RY-L02-S05-A04.title: Extraction / Upward Draw
RY-L02-S05-A04.description: Raising energy toward the upper chakras and transforming it.
RY-L02-S05-A04.effect: Intended to transform a bodily impulse into a subtler resource.

RY-L02-S05-A05.title: Yoni–Lingam
RY-L02-S05-A05.description: A tantric technique of uniting with external flows and the source tradition's concept of the buddhic body.
RY-L02-S05-A05.effect: Used symbolically for transformation of body awareness and consciousness.

RY-L02-S06-A01.title: Energy Circles
RY-L02-S06-A01.description: Gathering and accumulating energy in direct and reverse circulation.
RY-L02-S06-A01.effect: Used for self-practice and partner work through controlled energetic circulation.

RY-L02-S06-A02.title: Fireball through the Chakras
RY-L02-S06-A02.description: Working with energy at the level of chakras and their connections.
RY-L02-S06-A02.effect: Intended to create energetic forms and direct attention toward a chosen task.

RY-L02-S06-A03.title: Assemblage Point
RY-L02-S06-A03.description: Shifting the assemblage point toward a selected chakra in the source framework.
RY-L02-S06-A03.effect: Used to enter a desired state of consciousness for practice.
